data.one_liner: A simple QR scanner style overlay widget for a Stack with a camera scanner
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable QR scanner overlay widget that can be placed in a Stack alongside a camera scanner. It supports two modes: an overlay using an asset image path or an overlay using a solid color.
use_when: You need a visual targeting box or overlay for a QR or barcode scanner
You want to customize the scan area size, border color, border radius, and stroke width
avoid_when: You need actual camera scanning functionality built into the widget rather than just a UI overlay
You require network images for the overlay instead of local asset images
strengths: Simple and lightweight widget for Stack layouts
Supports custom colors or asset images for the overlay
Configurable scan area dimensions, border color, and border radius
weaknesses: Only supports local asset images for the image overlay mode
Does not handle camera logic on its own; requires a separate camera scanner
